seniorIsolation.title: Senior Isolation & Digital Divide
paragraphs: Many seniors feel left behind by rapidly advancing technology. This digital divide contributes to social isolation, limiting their ability to connect with family, access essential services, and participate fully in modern society.
Meanwhile, traditional tech support often lacks the patience and understanding that seniors need to feel comfortable learning new skills.

youthPurpose.title: Youth Seeking Purpose
paragraphs: Young people today want to make a meaningful impact in their communities. They possess natural tech skills and energy, but often lack opportunities to apply these abilities in service of others.
Many youth also miss out on the wisdom and life experience that comes from meaningful intergenerational relationships.

solution.description: We've created a unique model where both participants are teachers and learners. Seniors gain digital confidence while youth develop empathy, patience, and leadership skills.

curriculum.title: Digital Life Made Easy
curriculum.description: Our flagship 10-week program covers essential digital skills that matter most in daily life. Each week builds on the previous, ensuring solid foundations for lasting confidence.

weeks.title: Getting Started with Technology
weeks.content: Introduction to basic technology concepts, understanding different devices (smartphones, tablets, computers), and building confidence with turning devices on/off and basic navigation.

weeks.title: Device Navigation & Touch Basics
weeks.content: Learning how to use touchscreens, understanding gestures (tap, swipe, pinch), basic menu navigation, and adjusting display settings for better visibility.

weeks.title: Internet Basics & Web Browsing
weeks.content: Understanding what the internet is, how to open a web browser, basic search techniques, and navigating websites safely and effectively.

weeks.title: Email & Digital Communication
weeks.content: Setting up and using email, composing and sending messages, understanding attachments, and basic email organization and safety practices.

weeks.title: Video Calling & Staying Connected
weeks.content: Introduction to video calling platforms (Zoom, FaceTime, WhatsApp), making and receiving calls, and using these tools to connect with family and friends.

weeks.title: Telehealth & Medical Technology
weeks.content: Using technology for healthcare needs, scheduling online appointments, understanding patient portals, and accessing telehealth services safely.

weeks.title: Smart Home Basics
weeks.content: Introduction to smart home devices, voice assistants, smart thermostats, and other home automation tools that can improve daily life.

weeks.title: Online Banking & Financial Safety
weeks.content: Safely accessing online banking, understanding digital payments, recognizing secure websites, and protecting personal financial information.

weeks.title: Scam Awareness & Digital Safety
weeks.content: Identifying common online scams, understanding phishing attempts, creating strong passwords, and general digital safety best practices.

weeks.title: Putting It All Together
weeks.content: Review of all learned skills, troubleshooting common issues, resources for continued learning, and celebrating achievements.

faq.question: How much does the program cost?
faq.answer: Our programs are designed to be accessible and affordable. Costs vary based on the type of program and participant needs. Contact us for specific pricing information.

faq.question: What technology do I need to participate?
faq.answer: We work with whatever technology you have or help you identify appropriate devices. Common options include smartphones, tablets, or basic computers.

faq.question: How long are the programs?
faq.answer: Our flagship program "Digital Life Made Easy" runs for 10 weeks with weekly sessions. We also offer shorter workshops and ongoing support.

faq.question: Do I need any prior technology experience?
faq.answer: No prior experience is required! Our programs are designed for complete beginners and we meet you where you are.

faq.question: Are sessions in-person or virtual?
faq.answer: We offer both in-person and virtual options depending on your preference and location. Many participants enjoy a combination of both.

faq.question: How are youth volunteers trained?
faq.answer: All youth volunteers complete comprehensive training on communication, patience, and working with seniors before being matched with participants.
